description: WP-G2 Codex: Orks (11e) PILIN' OUT (Trukk) through the real enemy_ended_move window. Fixture ork11e_g2_pilin_out: P2 (Custodes) is active; the Nobz are embarked in P1's Trukk, Custodian Guard B is 12" away. A real click selects the Guard, the move is staged 5" (per-model STAGE_MODEL_MOVE, as the drag tool sends) and a real click on 'End This Unit's Move' ends it within 8" of the Trukk: P1's window opens with the free 'Pilin' Out' ability card. A real click on it starts the disembark follow-up for the Ork player: the Disembark dialog names the PILIN' OUT rapid disembark; a real click on Disembark and five real board clicks set the Nobz up wholly within 3" of the Trukk — rapid mode: not eligible to declare a charge, no further move; the follow-up ends and P2's phase resumes.
